Courses & menu

Four courses. They differ by the sushi and the steak cuts.

All prices are per person, tax included, food only. Every course can be booked for one guest. Add 2 hours of free-flow drinks for ¥2,000 (last order 30 minutes before the end). Dishes may change with the day's supply.

Lunch

Lunch starts at ¥1,800.

11:00 – 14:00 (last order 13:30)

Lunch course

¥1,800tax incl.

A four-dish course. Choose your main from four options, including hamburger steak and steak.

Wagyu sushi lunch, your choice

4 pieces ¥3,800 / 5 pieces ¥4,300 / 6 pieces ¥4,800tax incl.

Pick from five: wagyu short rib, Satsuma red chicken, NIKURA, Uniku and horse sashimi. Comes with salad, soup and ice cream. Add a petit cake and soft drink for ¥500.

Anniversary lunch course

¥6,800tax incl.

Green salad, grilled vegetables, wagyu short-rib sushi, 50 g wagyu tongue steak, 100 g wagyu steak, soup of the day and rice, finished with a whole cake and a message plate.

Seasonal

Seasonal & limited

Christmas dinner (1 – 25 December)

¥8,000 / ¥10,000tax incl.

For two guests, seven dishes. Two options: Christmas Dinner ¥8,000 (wagyu sirloin steak, beef tongue and more) and Premium Xmas ¥10,000 (wagyu fillet Rossini, lobster and more). Two seatings each evening.

Niku-no-hi course (the 29th of each month)

¥8,290tax incl.

Ten dishes, ¥8,290. Salt-truffle yukhoe, three kinds of wagyu sushi, sea urchin, salmon roe, sirloin and more.
